text: かてる　じしんが　あるなら　タケシと　たたかって　みなよ！

structure.jp: かてる　じしんが　あるなら
structure.en: if you're confident you can win

structure.jp: たたかって　みなよ！

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら gives a condition: 'if that's so'. じしんがあるなら = 'if you have confidence'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: たたかって　みなよ
patterns.explanation: てみる means try doing it. みな is a casual command and よ adds friendliness. たたかってみなよ = 'try fighting'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb before a noun describes it. かてるじしん = 'confidence that I can win'.
